limitations: Visual review uses sampled original frames and contact sheets, plus full-frame crop consistency checks; it is not continuous playback or semantic OCR of every frame.
Transition command and observation times are app/recording metadata with 0.5-second pre-command and 0.25-second post-observation buffers; they are not independently measured vehicle events.
This review verifies the final video and declared recording provenance. APK execution and source-code tests are separate evidence.

Synthetic traffic data and Android/AAOS emulator evidence do not establish received live traffic signals, sustained moving behavior, Pleos compatibility, production vehicle behavior or driving-use approval.
